claim_types.absolute_sota: Lowest same-protocol quality under any fully disclosed parameter, training and inference budget.
claim_types.equal_training_sota: Beat the anchor with matched parameter count and training sample/FLOP budget.
claim_types.equal_inference_sota: Beat the anchor with matched parameters, NFE, refiner steps and sample count.
claim_types.equal_quality_efficiency: Reach a frozen anchor quality threshold with fewer NFE, refiner steps, samples or measured GPU-seconds.

flowplace_dac26.reported_strength: zero-overlap, best OpenROAD PPA ranking, 10-50x faster sampling than the compared ChipDiffusion pipeline
flowplace_dac26.reuse_policy: paper-level mechanism only; clean-room implementation in existing modules

runtime_preflight.boundary: Single-batch preflight only; do not compare quality or infer full-cohort throughput.

capacity_cli_smoke.boundary: One-step plumbing smoke only; no quality claim.

training_compute_ladder.data_layer: frozen 20k-case subset before any full-data training
training_compute_ladder.early_stop: Do not advance a step count when both primary metrics fail to improve on the frozen subset.

high_block_count_branch.reason: The current 50k train cache covers 21-60 blocks, while Official-100 extends to 120. The 120-block Official-8 case dominates the current cost regression.
high_block_count_branch.promotion_rule: Improve the predeclared high-block slice without regressing low/mid-complexity cases at equal training exposure and inference budget.

inference_ladder.selection_policy: Only a deployable shared scorer may choose among samples. Oracle best-of-N is diagnostic only.

adaptive_inference.compute_accounting: Report NFE, refiner steps, generated draws, scorer calls, legalization work and wall time.

route_portfolio.success: Close the 20x d192 sample-exposure deficit at fixed parameter count.
Train on the frozen 21-120 distribution and remove 103/112/120-block extrapolation outliers.
Rejected on dev32: no energy-plateau, observable-rank or leave-one-case-out selector beats fixed refiner1600 under the declared total-compute and quality guard.
Screen d256/d384 under equal exposure and approximately equal FLOPs.
Retest larger data at the selected horizon with a fixed data order and stable seeds.

Before adding capacity, test a no-new-parameter projection-consistent flow using the existing hard projector at identical source noise, NFE, refiner and legalizer. U1 dynamic graph relay remains rejected.
Transfer improvements to routed PPA with a validated deployable response signal.
Certify Trinity flagship or the strongest exact same-protocol anchor under every disclosed budget field.

capacity_gate: A larger model must improve both primary metrics at equal training sample exposure and equal inference budget. Equal-step-only wins are insufficient.
sota_certification: Run exact Trinity d192 under matched model, training and inference budgets.
Run an exact strong anchor, preferably Trinity flagship 92.9M, under the declared absolute budget.
Treat FlowPlace as an external OpenROAD PPA anchor, but mark its comparable parameter count as unpublished and do not reuse its unlicensed source.
Report the selected model over a frozen single-sample and best-of-N Pareto ladder.
Keep external routed PPA and DRC/congestion/timing/power/area guards as independent endpoints.
Do not substitute cross-paper parameter or runtime comparisons for a local same-protocol result.
